payload.core_mechanism_summary: Brute-force check of all possible substring cuts by iterating start and end indices and testing if remaining parts equal target.
payload.rationale: The solution uses nested loops to try all cut positions, which is a complete search over all O(n^2) substrings. It does not employ pruning, recursion, or state-space exploration typical of backtracking, but among the given candidate subtypes, search_backtracking is the closest generic complete search label.
